headlines.title: Has PayPal Stock Become A Different Bet?
headlines.summary: PayPal (PYPL) stock is priced at 9.8 times earnings. That compares with a multiple of 21.5 for the broader S&P 500. Investors looking at that price need a clear picture of the underlying business. The company, meanwhile, has shifted its priorities. During earlier earnings calls, executives highlighted branded checkout, the PayPal option shoppers select when paying online. Checkout is no longer the headline. So what does PayPal's management lead with now.

headlines.title: What could trigger a US debt crisis? Sozzi discusses with economist Kenneth Rogoff
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes a look at the biggest stories as the trading day kicks off, weighing in on PepsiCo's (PEP) latest earnings results, General Motors' (GM) latest update, and more. Sozzi also sits down with Kenneth Rogoff, the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) former chief economist and Harvard University's current Maurits C. Boas chair and professor of international economics. The two discuss various looming risks to the US economy, including the deficit, the specter of a debt crisis, the AI economy's growing wealth divide, and more. Rogoff is also a chess grandmaster and former chess champion.

headlines.title: AI stocks are flying. These big names are falling behind
headlines.summary: As tech giants like Marvell (MRVL), Nvidia (NVDA) and AMD (AMD) climb to new highs, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes a look at the other side of the equation. Big-name companies like (NKE), McDonald's (MCD) and PayPa (PYPL) face an uphill battle to regain momentum and get back on track.

headlines.title: Sunbit Adds Three Senior Leaders from PayPal, LendingPoint and LendingClub
headlines.summary: LOS ANGELES, October 08, 2026--Sunbit today announced three additions to its leadership team. Becca Zoller Stone, Jessie Garton Szymanski and Anthony Suzara join the company.

headlines.title: PayPal’s AI Checkout Push and Agentic Commerce Vision Might Change The Case For Investing In PYPL
headlines.summary: In recent months, PayPal Holdings reported that its long-sluggish core checkout business has begun to stabilize, while it cuts costs, upgrades its technology stack, and channels resources into Venmo, Braintree, financial services and new AI-driven capabilities. The company is also building infrastructure for “agentic commerce,” where AI assistants complete purchases for users, potentially reshaping how its payments platform is used across the internet.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
